sections.title: The service
body: Exams connects candidates who want to book an exam seat with assistants who book it for them. Exams does not sell seats and is not affiliated with any exam centre.

sections.title: Price
body: Exams sets the price for each centre and level and shows it before you commit. It includes the assistant's share and a platform commission.

sections.title: Exam-centre credentials
body: Only enter them for yourself or for someone who agreed. They are encrypted, visible only to the assistant who takes the request, then deleted. Change your password after the booking.

sections.title: Payment and disputes
body: After the booking, you pay the assistant and the platform directly. If you disagree, Exams reviews the evidence and decides. An unpaid booking, an abusive dispute or fraud can lead to suspension or exclusion.

sections.title: Contact
body: contact@mrvin100.de

sections.title: Who we are
body: Exams (exams.mrvin100.de) connects language-exam candidates with assistants who book for them. For any question about your data: contact@mrvin100.de.

sections.title: Data we collect
body: Account: name, email address, profile picture if you sign in with Google or Microsoft, chosen language and role, date you accepted the terms.
Beneficiaries: name, email and exam-centre account password of the people you book for, with their consent.
Requests: session, level, amounts, statuses and dates.
Security: signed-in devices (browser, system, IP address) and sign-in logs.
Analytics: page views and anonymous events via Umami, without cookies or personal identification.

sections.title: Google (and Microsoft) data
body: If you choose “Continue with Google”, we only receive your name, email address and profile picture (openid, email and profile scopes). We never access your emails, contacts or files.
This data is only used to create your account and sign you in. It is not sold, not shared for advertising, and not used to train artificial-intelligence models.
Exams' use of information received from Google APIs adheres to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.

sections.title: Why we use it
body: To run the service: sign-in, posting requests, booking by an assistant, tracking and payment.
To secure accounts and prevent fraud (rate limits, two-step verification for administrators, sanctions for abuse).
To send the emails the service needs (sign-in codes, request updates).

sections.title: Sharing
body: A beneficiary's exam-centre password is only visible to the assistant who takes the request, during the booking. Candidates and assistants never see each other's identity, except the deposit account needed for payment.
Our technical processors: Vercel (hosting), Neon (database, European Union), Resend (email delivery), Umami (analytics). We never sell data.

sections.title: Retention
body: The exam-centre password is deleted as soon as the operation is closed.
Account data is kept while the account exists, then deleted within 30 days of its deletion, unless the law requires otherwise.

sections.title: Security
body: Encrypted connections (HTTPS). Exam-centre passwords encrypted with AES-256-GCM. Sign-in codes stored hashed. Administrator access protected by an authenticator app.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You can ask to access, correct, export or delete your data, and withdraw consent at any time, by writing to contact@mrvin100.de. You can also revoke Exams' access to your Google account at myaccount.google.com/permissions.

sections.title: Changes
body: We will announce any significant change on this page and, if needed, by email.
